title: The 8 Best Glue for Wood to Concrete 2026
h1: The 8 Best Glue for Wood to Concrete 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for glue for wood to concrete 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at glue for wood to concrete 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Liquid Nails LN-907 Extreme Heavy Duty Construction Adhesive
products.blurb: Key specs: 3,500 PSI bond strength, Works on wood, concrete, masonry, metal, Paintable after cure.
strengths: 3,500 PSI tensile strength is more than enough for framing and structural applications
40-minute adjustment time gives working room to position plates and sills accurately
Works on porous masonry surfaces that other adhesives cannot reach
Paintable after cure, no visible difference in finished surfaces
limitations: Requires caulk gun for application, adds to equipment cost if you do not own one
features: Works on wood, concrete, masonry, metal
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Loctite PL Premium Polyurethane Construction Adhesive
products.blurb: Key specs: Fast grab, reduces the need for temporary supports, All-weather formula, VOC compliant in all states.
strengths: Fast grab reduces the need for bracing and temporary clamps on vertical installations
VOC compliant, safer to use in enclosed spaces with limited ventilation
Bonds treated (pressure-treated) lumber without adhesion failure from preservative chemicals
for green lumber, works on freshly cut framing lumber before it dries
limitations: Faster grab means less repositioning time than standard Liquid Nails
features: Fast grab, reduces the need for temporary supports
Bonds green lumber, treated wood, and concrete

products.name: Gorilla 2 Part Epoxy Syringe (Pack of 4)
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-minute set time, Waterproof, Works on wood, concrete, metal, ceramic.
strengths: Epoxy creates a mechanical bond in the porous concrete surface, different mechanism than construction adhesive
Waterproof after cure, suitable for concrete with intermittent moisture
5-minute set allows one-step application without temporary support
Works on irregular surfaces where construction adhesive may not make consistent contact
limitations: 5-minute open time too short for large-area applications
Higher cost per bond area than construction adhesive
features: Works on wood, concrete, metal, ceramic

products.name: West System 105 Epoxy Resin with 205 Fast Hardener Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: Low viscosity, penetrates into concrete, Marine-grade waterproof, High tensile strength.
strengths: Low viscosity penetrates into concrete pores, creates a mechanical bond deeper than contact-only adhesives
Marine-grade waterproofing, handles basement and exterior applications with ground moisture
Structural application, load-bearing joints are within its design envelope
Mixing kit allows controlling open time with different hardener choices

products.name: Sikabond-T21 All-in-One Polyurethane Adhesive for Wood Floors
products.blurb: Key specs: Elastic adhesive for wood flooring over concrete, Absorbs movement and vibration, One-component polyurethane.
strengths: Elastic after cure, absorbs seasonal wood movement across concrete that rigid adhesives would crack
Full-spread trowel application bonds the entire floor surface evenly, better than spot bonding
Specifically designed for direct-glue wood flooring over concrete slabs
No floating floor movement, glued floor is silent, stable, and professional quality
limitations: Trowel application requires a notched spreader and proper technique
features: Elastic adhesive for wood flooring over concrete

products.name: DAP Weldwood FRP Construction Adhesive
products.blurb: Key specs: Paintable and stainable, Interior and exterior, Non-flammable formula.
strengths: Non-flammable formula, safer to use near pilot lights and in enclosed spaces
Paintable and stainable after cure, no evidence of adhesive at seams
Interior and exterior rated, handles basement and covered exterior applications
Lowest price per tube on the list
limitations: Lower stated bond strength than Liquid Nails Heavy Duty
Shorter shelf life after opening than some alternatives

products.name: 3M Marine Adhesive Sealant 5200
products.blurb: Key specs: Permanent polyurethane sealant and adhesive, Above and below waterline use, Permanently flexible after cure.
strengths: Permanently flexible, absorbs constant movement and vibration between wood and concrete
Above and below waterline, the most aggressive waterproofing rating
Used in marine construction, the highest durability standard available
Creates both a bond and a watertight seal simultaneously
limitations: Permanent, bonds are extremely difficult to break without damaging one or both surfaces
Higher price than standard construction adhesive
Slow cure: 5–7 days for full strength
features: High adhesion to wood and masonry

products.name: Franklin Titebond Weatherproof Subfloor Adhesive
products.blurb: Key specs: Low VOC, solvent-free formula, All-weather performance, High bond strength.
strengths: Low VOC, solvent-free formula, important for use in homes, schools, and occupied spaces
All-weather formula cures reliably even in cooler or damp job-site conditions
High bond strength for subfloor and framing-grade adhesion to masonry and concrete
Works on green lumber, does not fail on freshly cut treated framing material
limitations: Water-based formula cleans up easily but may require longer support time vs solvent-based
Less widely available than Liquid Nails
features: Works on green and treated lumber
